description: Design-A-thon is a premier UI/UX hackathon that challenges participants to transform real-world problems into innovative, user-centric design solutions . Organized by Strokes, the official design club of IIIT Nagpur , this event pushes participants to explore the boundaries of creativity, problem-solving, and design methodologies under pressure. The competition is designed to simulate real-world design challenges through case studies, user research, and time-bound hackathon-style rounds. Beyond just visuals, the focus is on creating designs that are functional, inclusive, and impactful , delivering meaningful user experiences. What We’re Looking For Teams who can think creatively and craft visually stunning yet user-friendly interfaces . Designers who can deliver seamless, intuitive, and thoughtful user journeys . Participants ready to take on surprise challenges and constraints , adapting flexibly while maintaining design quality. Problem solvers who can balance creativity with functionality and inclusivity . Key Details Design skills will be tested in realistic, case-driven environments . Participants will work on dynamic problem statements with unexpected twists. The goal is to inspire creativity while grounding designs in practical usability and accessibility . Event Structure Round 1 – Online Case Study Submission Participants will undertake a research-driven design project , such as: Creating user personas Conducting heuristic evaluations of popular designs Critiquing design flaws in major platforms/projects Each case study submission must include: Research findings with insights and data Clear identification of UX issues and pain points Practical recommendations for design improvements Mockups, wireframes, or prototypes showcasing solutions Submission Format: One comprehensive PDF case study Supporting visuals (PNG/JPEG/PDF) Optional: Video explanation of design process Optional: Figma or source files as supplementary material Timeline: 10th oct, 12:00 AM – 1

raw.details:
Design-A-thon is a premier UI/UX hackathon that challenges participants to transform real-world problems into innovative, user-centric design solutions. Organized by Strokes, the official design club of IIIT Nagpur, this event pushes participants to explore the boundaries of creativity, problem-solving, and design methodologies under pressure.

The competition is designed to simulate real-world design challenges through case studies, user research, and time-bound hackathon-style rounds. Beyond just visuals, the focus is on creating designs that are functional, inclusive, and impactful, delivering meaningful user experiences.

What We’re Looking For

  • Teams who can think creatively and craft visually stunning yet user-friendly interfaces.
  • Designers who can deliver seamless, intuitive, and thoughtful user journeys.
  • Participants ready to take on surprise challenges and constraints, adapting flexibly while maintaining design quality.
  • Problem solvers who can balance creativity with functionality and inclusivity.

Key Details

  • Design skills will be tested in realistic, case-driven environments.
  • Participants will work on dynamic problem statements with unexpected twists.
  • The goal is to inspire creativity while grounding designs in practical usability and accessibility.

Event Structure

Round 1 – Online Case Study Submission

Participants will undertake a research-driven design project, such as:

  • Creating user personas
  • Conducting heuristic evaluations of popular designs
  • Critiquing design flaws in major platforms/projects

Each case study submission must include:

  • Research findings with insights and data
  • Clear identification of UX issues and pain points
  • Practical recommendations for design improvements
  • Mockups, wireframes, or prototypes showcasing solutions

Submission Format:

  • One comprehensive PDF case study
  • Supporting visuals (PNG/JPEG/PDF)
  • Optional: Video explanation of design process
  • Optional: Figma or source files as supplementary material

Timeline: 10th oct, 12:00 AM – 19 Oct, 11:59 PM

Round 2 – Offline Finals (16-Hour Hackathon)

A 16-hour on-campus design hackathon where teams receive the problem statement at the start. They must research, ideate, and deliver a complete design solution within the deadline.

Key Details:

  • Deliverables include wireframes, prototypes, and final designs
  • Teams may use any design tools or collaboration platforms
  • Judging criteria: Functionality, creativity, user experience, aesthetics, adaptability
  • Surprise twists may include target audience shifts, theme reversals, limited palettes, or mandatory design elements

Timeline: 25th Oct, 9:00 PM – 26th Oct, 3:00 PM

Evaluation Criteria

Round 1 – Case Study

  • Research depth & clarity
  • Identification of design flaws
  • Feasibility of recommendations
  • Quality of supporting prototypes
  • Professional presentation

Round 2 – Offline Finals

  • Creativity & innovation of design
  • Usability & functionality
  • Adherence to problem statement
  • Visual & aesthetic quality
  • Adaptability to restrictions
  • Presentation clarity

Eligibility

  • Open to all students across India (any discipline)
  • Teams of 2–4 members, or individuals allowed
  • Cross-college & cross-specialization teams welcome
  • Each participant can only join one team

Submission Requirements (Final Round)

  • A Figma design file link containing:
    • Research insights
    • Wireframes
    • Prototypes
    • Final design
    • Dedicated presentation section
  • File must be set to “anyone with the link can view”

General Rules & Guidelines

  • All submissions must be original work (strict no-plagiarism policy)
  • Participants must bring their own laptops/equipment for offline rounds
  • Respect IIITN’s campus rules and code of conduct
  • Organizers’ and judges’ decisions are final.
